import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class B {

    public static void main(String args[]) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String s = br.readLine().trim();
        int n = s.length();
        
        long count = 0;
        
        // Try all possible digits for X (0-9)
        for (char x = '0'; x <= '9'; x++) {
            // Generate the string with X replaced by x
            char[] generated = new char[n];
            boolean valid = true;
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                if (s.charAt(i) == 'X') {
                    generated[i] = x;
                } else {
                    generated[i] = s.charAt(i);
                }
            }
            
            // Count number of underscores
            int underscoreCount = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                if (generated[i] == '_') {
                    underscoreCount++;
                }
            }
            
            // Try all possible replacements for underscores
            long total = (long)Math.pow(10, underscoreCount);
            
            // Check each possible number
            for (long num = 0; num < total; num++) {
                char[] finalNum = new char[n];
                int temp = (int)num;
                
                // Fill in underscores from right to left
                for (int i = n - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
                    if (generated[i] == '_') {
                        finalNum[i] = (char)('0' + (temp % 10));
                        temp /= 10;
                    } else {
                        finalNum[i] = generated[i];
                    }
                }
                
                // Check for leading zero
                if (finalNum[0] == '0' && n > 1) {
                    continue;
                }
                
                // Check if divisible by 25
                int lastTwo = (finalNum[n-2] - '0') * 10 + (finalNum[n-1] - '0');
                if (lastTwo % 25 == 0) {
                    count++;
                }
            }
        }
        
        System.out.println(count);
    }
}
